release-header.name: J100 SIP 4.0.9.0 Release 11
release-header.description:
Copyright Avaya Inc. 2002 2003 2004 2005 2006 2007 2008 2009 2010 2011 2012 2013 2014 2015 2016 2017 2018 2019 2020 2021 All rights reserved. This file describes the contents of the software distribution package for the J100 SIP IP Telephones.
The reason for the release of this software is: - The R4.0.9.0 release 11 of J100 SIP Software for J129, J139, J159, J169, J179 or J189 Telephones. - The R1.0.1.0 release 23 of software for J100 Expansion Module
There is one firmware version with multiple language files in this distribution package. It is available in one format - zip. This release supports an upgrade strategy only for SIP software. This software distribution package contains all the files necessary to upgrade an Avaya J129, J139, J159, J169, J179 or J189 to SIP software.
The following files are included in the package: J100Supgrade.txt - This file is downloaded by the Avaya IP telephones and instructs each telephone on how to upgrade itself. This file SHOULD NOT BE EDITED. System specific parameters should be entered into the 46xxsettings.txt file, which is available for separate download at support.avaya.com.
To upgrade your Avaya IP Telephones: - Rename your current J100Supgrade.txt file. - Unzip the zip file in the outbound file directory of your HTTP server. - Make any adjustments to your 46xxsettings.txt file. - Reset your Avaya IP Telephones.
